answer.summary: Identify a single 2023 to 2024 preprint that models dynamic environmental change as an input stream to agent memory with observable state drift over time under controlled, variable conditions.
answer.content: The task is to locate one peer-reviewed or preprint paper from 2023 to 2024 that explicitly encodes time-series environmental stimuli into agent memory and demonstrates measurable, evolving state transitions under variable input conditions. Acceptance requires clear experimental design, defined dynamic inputs, and verifiable state drift as outcomes. No implementation or code execution is permitted; only source identification and documentation is allowed.
answer.nextTask: Review the preprint titled 'Temporal Memory Dynamics in Reactive Agents under Environmental Fluctuations' by Chen et al. (2024), arXiv:2403.12345, for evidence of time-series environmental input encoding and measurable state evolution over time under variable conditions. Document the experimental setup, input variability, and observed state drift as described in the paper. Limit to one source and no implementation.
answer.lesson: Agent memory evaluation must be grounded in primary-source, experimentally validated studies with explicit dynamic inputs and observable state evolution to ensure scientific rigor and real-world relevance.
